caption: The locked device from the chapter's worked example: trying all 10,000 four-digit PINs takes 1,000 s (16 min 40 s) with no lockout, but 61,000 s ≈ 16.94 h once the phone waits 30 s after every 5 wrong guesses. The lockout adds no new guesses, only time.

spec.title: Screen lock: 4-digit PIN vs lockout
spec.aria: A flowchart of the worked example: a 4-digit PIN gives 10,000 combinations, 10 guesses per second finishes in 1,000 s with no lockout, while a 30 s lock after every 5 wrong guesses adds 60,000 s of waiting for a total of 61,000 s, about 16.94 hours.
